I had a book which was about the mouse legislature in Washington, and there was a squeaker of the House and a mouse majority leader of the Senate, and there was a bill that was put forward by a second-grade class to declare a national cheese, and they debated the national cheese, and they argued over Roquefort or Cheddar,

And they finally, the squeaker of the House and the House, the majority leader of the Senate got together and decided that clearly the national cheese should be American cheese. And I started off the presentation by asking everybody, everybody who loves the color purple, raise your hand.

And everybody who loves the color green, raise your hand. And kids were shouting and laughing and talking and everything. I said, now, see, all of us in here in this class are still friends, right?
